salvo: salvo14/mig/s6 (9 Nov 2026), lot k-openai-2 (c2-openai). Precedent labels versus facts in LLM policy decisions. GPT-5.6 Luna column of Table 3: L (label effect: APPROVE-minus-DENY approval difference, in points) on fictional policies and on nine public policies, and F (facts contrast, approve-side minus deny-side rate) on nine public policies; 95% intervals in brackets are kept in the notes. These are BIAS measures (percentage points of effect), not quality scores: doubt of use kept. GPT-5.6 Luna runs with API-default reasoning effort and a 6,000-token output limit, temperature 1.0 (API default), calls made in October 2026; fictional policies through the OpenAI API, public policies through an Azure OpenAI deployment of the same model (gpt-5.6-luna-2026-07-09). The top block of Table 3 (approval rates) is for DeepSeek V4.1 Flash only.
